verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a dedicated multilingual voice agent setup, where the developer picks the STT and TTS models for the languages involved. That covers running conversations in multiple languages. Nothing in the pack shows automatic language detection or switching language mid-call. Missing for 10: documented mid-call language detection, documented mid-call language switching, list of supported languages, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run conversations in multiple languages, including detecting and switching language mid-call

citations.quote: A multilingual voice agent has two model decisions: which STT model transcribes the user, and which TTS model speaks the agent.
